answer:
The person who said "Now, I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds" is **J. Robert Oppenheimer**, the American theoretical physicist who served as the director of the Manhattan Project during World War II. This quote was famously attributed to him after witnessing the first nuclear test (Trinity test) in 1945, when he recalled verses from the Bhagavad Gita.

J. Robert Oppenheimer was born on **April 22, 1904**, in New York City, New York.
